artworks.title: Cadmus and the Spartoi
artworks.description: Solis' Metamorphoses plate: Cadmus watches the Spartoi rise and slaughter one another — Udaeus among the five earth-born survivors who seed Thebes' nobility.

artworks.title: Cadmus Sows the Dragon's Teeth Which Turn into Armed Men
artworks.description: Goltzius' LACMA engraving for Ovid III: armed men spring from the sown teeth — the prodigy that leaves Udaeus and four comrades as Thebes' autochthonous houses.

artworks.title: Cadmus and the Spartoi (Wallenstein Palace)
artworks.description: Prague's Wallenstein mythological corridor stages Cadmus with the Spartoi — the sown warriors among whom Udaeus stands as ancestor of the Theban line of Tiresias.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus names Udaeus among the five surviving Spartoi — the sown man whose descendants include the seer Tiresias.

popCulture.title: Dragon's teeth (mythology)
popCulture.description: Cadmus sows Ares' dragon's teeth and raises the Spartoi — Udaeus one of the five who live when the rest kill each other.

popCulture.title: Udaeus (mythology)
popCulture.description: One of the five original Spartoi of Thebes — earth-born warrior and ancestor in the Theban stemma.
